method: Read original question/task, mutated target function, actual submitted production patch, required F2P bodies and relevant original oracle logs; bounded real Python behavior for specific contradictions. No all-task/full-repository sweep, no new test files, no new task IDs or reward relabeling.
oracle_boundary: All required F2P test bodies in this range contain an assertion/raises-style observation, unlike the separate print-only OSA finding. This is a source observation, not evidence of exhaustive semantic coverage; no false-positive full-oracle production counterexample was established here.

task_reviews.analysis: 题面把当前yaml.load无Loader调用描述为已能执行任意YAML对象；真实baseline原日志是TypeError: load() missing Loader。原CLI例也未选择yaml target format。safe_load修复兼容并采用安全语义，但“漏洞已可执行”的现状没有被此环境证实。
